activity.notes: Oxford places Polycrates' seizure of power on Samos around 535 BCE and his death around 522 BCE. ATLAS records the Samian tyranny rather than generic Greece and retains approximate endpoints.

sources.title: Polycrates, tyrant of Samos - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Polycrates as tyrant of Samos, from c.535 to c.522 BCE.
